description: This file defines the ThemeInitialization class in Drupal, responsible for theme setup, including loading themes, managing theme assets, and handling theme dependencies.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Theme\ThemeInitialization
classes.description: Provides theme initialization logic, including loading themes, managing assets, and handling dependencies.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Theme\ActiveTheme
classes.description: Represents an active theme with its properties such as path, name, logo, libraries, and extensions.

methods.name: initTheme
methods.description: Initializes and loads the specified theme by name.

methods.name: getActiveThemeByName
methods.description: Retrieves the active theme object by theme name, using cache or fallback to default.

methods.name: loadActiveTheme
methods.description: Loads the theme's engine and extensions, including deprecated engine inclusion.

methods.name: getActiveTheme
methods.description: Constructs an ActiveTheme object with theme details, including libraries and extensions.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns all extensions (modules and themes) available.
